title: Clashing edits: the status bar says so, and Compare keeps yours or theirs
steps: Open Shopping and start typing on a line, staying in insert mode. From a terminal, change that same line: COMMON_INK_URL=<this Preview> bin/common-ink write Shopping.md (or have an agent do it). Press Esc.
The status bar says "Not saved: this note changed in the same place elsewhere.", with Compare… beside it. Click it: the two versions as a diff, and who made theirs.
Keep mine saves yours; theirs is still in History. Or Use theirs: the editor changes to theirs, and u brings yours back.
Do the same with the test lever offline (⌘⇧P, Test levers: Go offline): back online, the status bar says the edit can't be merged, and a click on it compares.
